# pheno-domain

## Overview

Canonical domain primitives for the `pheno-*` fleet.
Newtype wrappers (EntityId, Timestamp, Slug, Email, Money) with validation,
serde, and Display so they cross API boundaries without ceremony.

## Install

Add to `Cargo.toml`:

```toml
pheno-domain = { path = "../pheno-domain" }
```

## Quickstart

```rust
use pheno_domain::{EntityId, Timestamp, Slug, Email, Money, DomainError};

let id = EntityId::new_v4();
let ts = Timestamp::now();
let slug: Slug = "hello-world".parse()?;
let email: Email = "user@example.com".parse()?;
let money = Money::new("10.99".parse()?, "USD")?;
```

## Public API

- `EntityId(Uuid)` — `new_v4()`, `inner()`, `Display`, `FromStr`, `Serialize`, `Deserialize`.
- `Timestamp(DateTime<Utc>)` — `now()`, `inner()`, `Display`, `FromStr`, `Serialize`, `Deserialize`.
- `Slug(String)` — `as_str()`, `MIN_LEN = 3`, `MAX_LEN = 64`, `Display`, `FromStr`, `TryFrom<String>`.
- `Email(String)` — `as_str()`, `Display`, `FromStr`, `TryFrom<String>`.
- `Money { amount, currency }` — `new(amount, currency)`, `amount()`, `currency()`, `Display`, `FromStr`.
- `DomainError` — `InvalidFormat`, `OutOfRange`, `InvalidValue` with `thiserror` messages.

## Validation Rules

| Type      | Rule                                           |
|-----------|------------------------------------------------|
| `EntityId`| Valid v4 UUID                                  |
| `Timestamp`| RFC 3339 UTC datetime                         |
| `Slug`    | lowercase ASCII, digits, hyphens; 3–64 chars   |
| `Email`   | loose RFC regex (pragmatic, not deliverability) |
| `Money`   | amount rounds to 2 dp; currency is 3-char code |

## Scope-Out

- No application-specific types (e.g. `OrderId`) — add in downstream crates.
- No persistence layer — these are plain data types.
- No currency conversion logic.

## Dependencies

serde, thiserror, uuid, chrono, regex, rust_decimal.
